text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — the big community granola jar is basically empty this morning, found the empty bag in the sink area :eyes:
sam: yikes, I grabbed a handful yesterday but definitely not the whole bag :grimacing:
matt: I noticed the same, thought it was low but not gone. anyone know if we moved it to the meeting room?
kitchen-bot: low-stock alert: almond milk 1 carton left, granola 0 remaining. Please update the kitchen inventory spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/kitchen-inventory
laura: I can bring a fresh tub of homemade granola tomorrow (gluten-free option too) — would it help to label jars with allergy notes?
rachel: yes please label. also can we please start putting names on anything we take for lunches? too many mystery lunches lately :sweat_smile:
mark: happy to make a tiny sticker template. Dan, do you still have the label printer config?
dan: yup, here's the quick label command for the Brother QL:
```
ql2200 --text "Granola (GF) — Shared — No Dairy" --qty 1
```

ops: suggestion — can we switch to pre-portioned packets for high-traffic snacks? less temptation to take the whole jar.
elaine: quick poll: keep communal jar (label + bake rota) vs pre-portioned packets? react with :hand: for jar, :package: for packets.
sam: :hand: (jar + labels)
matt: :package: (packets are tidy)
laura: :hand: I can do a every-3-weeks baking rota if people want to chip in for ingredients.
rachel: also FYI — somebody left a milk carton with no name in the fridge labeled only "coffee milk". If it's yours, claim it before it becomes science.
mark: will print labels and leave tape + stickers by the printer.
elaine: thanks! I'll update the sheet and add a "kitchen etiquette" note. if no objections, I’ll order a spare tub of GF granola for tomorrow.
ops: no objections from infra, go ahead. :thumbsup:
matt: volunteering to restock oats and tea this week.
dan: label printer is in the supply closet next to the big cabinet (code 1122). leave a note if you use it.
elaine: awesome. outcome: label plan + bake rota + one emergency tub ordered. mystery granola detective work continues :mag:
